verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5080 is a graphics card. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a software workflow-management axis, so the question is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships an automation system with version history or rollback; mentions of ComfyUI workflows and G-Assist describe running AI locally, not managing automation versions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
